The Tejon Ranch Co. (the “Company”) announced in a press release issued October 29, 2026 (the “Press Release”) that it will hold a conference call on November 5, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time for the Company’s shareholders and other interested parties in connection with the Company’s release of third quarter 2026 operating and financial results, which will be released before the market opens on November 5, 2026. During the conference call the Company will address questions that are emailed in advance, instructions for which are provided in the Press Release. Information on how interested shareholders and other parties may register to attend this event is included in the Press Release. A copy of this release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. The information in this Current Report on Form 8-K (including the exhibit attached as Exhibit 99.1 hereto) is being furnished pursuant to Item 7.01 of Form 8-K and shall not be deemed to be “filed” for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall it be deemed to be incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act (including the exhibit attached as Exhibit 99.1 hereto).
